summary: Costamare Bulkers Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K with its unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements for the six-month period ended June 30, 2026. The filing is a routine periodic report by a foreign private issuer, incorporating the financial statements by reference into its Form F-3 registration statement. No transaction, corporate action, or special situation is described. The report contains standard balance sheet, income statement, and equity data, including FFA derivatives and bunker swaps disclosures. This is a routine interim financial reporting event with no strategic implications; the appropriate classification is None.
